subject: Human Body
title: How Hair Grows
description: A fast breakdown of How Hair Grows for builders.

hook.text: That strand on your head is dead. Only the root inside the follicle is alive. Hair is a ribbon of dead keratin cells.

buildup.text: The hair follicle is a tiny organ in the dermis.

discovery.text: Each follicle cycles through growth (2–7 yrs), regression (2 wks), and rest (3 months) before shedding and restarting.

twist.text: You lose 50–100 hairs daily during the resting phase. This is normal shedding.

climax.text: Hair growth is cyclic and independent per follicle.

punchline.text: Every hair keeps its own clock. Growth, rest, shed, repeat.

quiz.question: Why don't all hairs fall out at the same time?
options: The brain synchronizes hair loss across the scalp
Each follicle operates on its own independent growth cycle
Only damaged hairs fall out; healthy ones never shed
